l-e-e2-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Naming words (nouns) only name people or animals" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).

l-e-e2-b01-02.s.s1.explain: "Table" bụ aha ihe, ma ọ bụ noun. Nouns na-akpọ mmadụ, anụmanụ, na ihe aha.

l-e-e2-b02-01.title: Azịza ajụjụ malitere na Do ọ̀ bụ Yes mgbe niile?
l-e-e2-b02-01.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na a na-aza ajụjụ malitere na Do mgbe niile “Yes, I do.” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-abụghị.
l-e-e2-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Azịza ajụjụ malitere na Do bụ mgbe niile “Yes, I do.” Chọta ajụjụ na azịza na-emegide ya.
l-e-e2-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Azịza ya bụ Yes, I do. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Azịza ya bụ Yes, I do. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-01.s.s1.r.d: Azịza ya bụ Yes, I do. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ihe ahụ adịghị amasị gị, ị na-aza “No, I don't.” Azịza dabere n’otú obi dị gị.
l-e-e2-b02-01.s.s2.model.0: Ị nwere ike ịza “Do you like milk?” site na “No, I don't.”; ya mere nkwupụta na azịza bụ Yes mgbe niile ezighi ezi.

l-e-e2-b02-02.title: A na-eji an naanị tupu mkpụrụedemede vowel?
l-e-e2-b02-02.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na a na-eji an naanị tupu okwu malitere na mkpụrụedemede vowel bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-abụghị.
l-e-e2-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: a na-eji an naanị tupu okwu malitere na a, e, i, o, u. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e2-b02-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ okwu na-emegide nkwupụta (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e2-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-amalite na a. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.

l-e-e2-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-amalite na i. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-02.s.s1.explain: hour na-amalite na h, ma a naghị akpọ h, okwu ahụ na-amalite na ụda vowel; ya mere a na-eji an.
l-e-e2-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: hour na-amalite na h ma ka na-eji an; ya mere nkwupụta na an bụ naanị tupu mkpụrụedemede vowel ezighi ezi.

l-e-e2-b02-03.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na ahịrịokwu mbụ nke ozi dị mkpirikpi na-amalite mgbe niile na aha mmadụ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-abụghị.
l-e-e2-b02-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu mbụ nke ozi dị mkpirikpi na-amalite mgbe niile na aha mmadụ. Chọta ozi na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ozi na-emegide nkwupụta (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-amalite na Mina. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-amalite na Sam. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-amalite na Jun. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s1.explain: “It is rainy.” na-amalite na ihu igwe. Ozi nwekwara ike ịmalite n’okwu na-abụghị aha mmadụ.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: E nwere ozi na-amalite na “It is rainy.”; ya mere nkwupụta na ha na-amalite mgbe niile na aha mmadụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e2-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: Ụfọdụ ozi na-ekwu maka ihu igwe na mbụ, ya mere ọ bụghị ahịrịokwu mbụ niile na-amalite na aha mmadụ.

l-e-e2-b02-04.title: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla ọ na-amalite na okwu mmadụ?
l-e-e2-b02-04.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na ahịrịokwu Bekee na-amalite na okwu na-akọ mmadụ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-abụghị.
l-e-e2-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu Bekee na-amalite mgbe niile na okwu mmadụ (I, You, aha). Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide ya.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-amalite na I. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-amalite na You. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-amalite na aha mmadụ. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s1.explain: “The sun is hot.” na-amalite na anyanwụ (ihe). Ahịrịokwu nwekwara ike ịmalite n’okwu gbasara ihe na-abụghị mmadụ.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: “The sun is hot.” bụ ahịrịokwu gbasara anyanwụ; ya mere nkwupụta na ọ na-amalite na okwu mmadụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e2-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: E nwekwara ahịrịokwu na-amalite na The sun, nke na-akpọ ihe; ya mere nkwupụta a ezighi ezi.

l-e-e2-b02-05.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na ngwaa na-abịa mgbe niile na njedebe ahịrịokwu Bekee bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-abụghị.
l-e-e2-b02-05.material: Nkwupụta: N’ahịrịokwu Bekee, ngwaa na-abịa mgbe niile na njedebe. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide ya.
l-e-e2-b02-05.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaa eat dị na njedebe. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.
l-e-e2-b02-05.s.s1.r.c: Ngwaa run dị na njedebe. Ihe atụ a dabara nkwupụta.

l-e-e2-b03-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “Okwu mgbe I like na-agwụ na s mgbe niile” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e2-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu mgbe I like na-agwụ na s mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e2-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: dogs nwere s. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e2-b03-08.material: Ederede: Sora has three apples. Sora gives one apple to Pat. Ajụjụ: Sora nwere apụl abụọ ugbu a. Anyị chọrọ ilele ma nke a ziri ezi.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji lelee?
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu anaghị agwa gị ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.r.b: Afọ enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ọnụọgụ apụl fọdụrụ.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.o.c: Ole dị na mbụ na ole e nyere
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.r.d: Agba enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ole fọdụrụ.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s1.explain: Site na 3 mbụ, inye 1 na-ahapụ 2. Ị chọrọ ịmata ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ iji lelee.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s2.model.0: Ị chọrọ ịmata ọnụọgụ mbụ na ọnụọgụ e nyere iji wepụ 1 site na 3 ma chọta ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ, ya mere a chọrọ ozi abụọ ahụ.
l-e-e2-b03-08.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ ka a na-achọta site n'iwepụ ọnụọgụ e nyere site n'ọnụọgụ mbụ, ya mere ọnụọgụ mbụ na ọnụọgụ e nyere bụ ihe a chọrọ kpamkpam.

l-e-e2-b03-09.title: Ọkwa maka ịhọrọ n'etiti This na That
l-e-e2-b03-09.goal: Iji chọta okwu a na-eji mgbe a na-atụ aka n'pensụl dị n'elu tebụl, kewaa ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e2-b03-09.material: Ị na-atụ aka n'pensụl dị n'elu tebụl ma na-ekwu “___ is my pencil.” Dee This ma ọ bụ That n'oghere ahụ.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịmata kpamkpam iji họrọ?
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo anaghị ekewa This na That.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.r.b: Ole dị bụ ozi na-ekewa This na These.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.r.c: Agba anaghị ekewa This na That.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.o.d: Ma pensụl ahụ dị nso m ma ọ bụ dị anya
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Jiri This maka ihe dị nso na That maka ihe dị anya. Anya bụ ọkwa ahụ.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: Nso bụ This anya bụkwa That, ya mere ma pensụl ahụ dị nso m bụ ozi a chọrọ kpamkpam.
l-e-e2-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: Agba na ogologo anaghị ekewa This na That, ya mere ị chọrọ ịmata anya.

l-e-e2-b03-10.title: Ọkwa maka ikewa omume na-eme ụda
l-e-e2-b03-10.goal: Iji kewaa omume sing, shout, sit, sleep, kewaa ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e2-b03-10.material: Anyị chọrọ ikewa kaadị omume sing, shout, sit, sleep n'ìgwè abụọ. sing na shout bụ otu ìgwè.
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s1.o.a: Ma ọ bụ omume na-eme ụda
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s1.r.b: shout na sleep nwere mkpụrụedemede 5 mana ha nọ n'ìgwè dị iche.
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s1.r.c: Okwu anọ ahụ niile na-amalite na s, ya mere enweghị ike ikewa ha.
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s1.r.d: sing na sit nwere i mana ha nọ n'ìgwè dị iche.
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s1.explain: sing na shout na-eme ụda, sit na sleep anaghị eme.
l-e-e2-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: sing na shout bụ omume na-eme ụda, sit na sleep abụghị, ya mere ụda bụ ọkwa ahụ.

l-e-e2-b04-06.title: Ihe ngosi iji kewaa like na likes
l-e-e2-b04-06.goal: Iji chọta ihe ngosi na-ekewa like na likes, chọpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e2-b04-06.material: She likes tea. / I like tea. / My dog likes milk. / We like milk. Ị chọrọ ịkewa ahịrịokwu anọ ahụ n'ndị ebe ngwaa bụ like na ndị ebe ọ bụ likes.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ngosi kacha mma maka ịkewa?
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.o.a: Ma isiokwu bụ I ma ọ bụ We, ma ọ bụ otu onye ma ọ bụ otu anụmanụ
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma ihe ọṅụṅụ bụ tea ma ọ bụ milk
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụlagodi na otu ihe ọṅụṅụ, like na likes na-agbanwe.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe ọ gbasara udi ngwaa.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu anọ ahụ niile nwere period, ya mere enweghị ike ịkewa ha.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Jiri like na I na We, na likes na She na My dog, nke bụ otu onye ma ọ bụ otu anụmanụ.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: I na We na-ewe like, She na My dog na-ewekwa likes, ya mere isiokwu bụ ihe ngosi.
l-e-e2-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na otu ihe ọṅụṅụ, ngwaa na-agbanwe, ya mere ị ghaghị ilele onye na-ahụ ya n'anya.

l-e-e2-b04-07.goal: Iji chọta ihe ngosi na-ekewa okwu isii n'otu na ọtụtụ, chọpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.

l-e-e2-b04-07.s.s1.r.d: E dị n'ma apple ma eggs, ya mere ọ nweghị ihe ọ gbasara ọnụọgụ.

l-e-e2-b04-08.s.s1.r.d: Ụbọchị na-agwa mgbe. Ọ bụghị ihe a ga-eweta.

l-e-e2-b07-07.goal: Chọpụta kedu ụkpụrụ (ozi) achọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ihe ga-abanye n'ebe efu nke "I have a cat. ___ cat is white.", ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e2-b07-07.material: Ị chọrọ itinye ma a ma ọ bụ The n'ebe efu nke "I have a cat. ___ cat is white." Kpebie ozi achọrọ n'ezie.
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: Otú ọ si mara mma adịghị ekewa a na The.
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s1.o.b: Ma ọ na-abịa n'mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrị okwu
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: N'mmalite, A bụ naanị mkpụrụedemede ukwu ma ọ naghị ekewa ha abụọ.
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede adịghị ekewa a na The.

l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s1.explain: Jiri The mgbe ị na-ekwu banyere nwamba a kpọtụrụ aha na mbụ ọzọ. Jiri a mgbe ị na-ekwu ya nke mbụ.
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ kwuru a cat na mbụ ma na-ekwu banyere otu nwamba ahụ ọzọ, ya mere jiri The.
l-e-e2-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Ma a kpọtụrụ nwamba ahụ aha na mbụ bụ ihe na-ekewa a na The, ya mere a chọrọ ozi a n'ezie.

l-e-e2-b01-11.title: Ụkpụrụ maka ime ajụjụ "Do you like ~?"
l-e-e2-b01-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụkpụrụ maka ịtụgharị ahịrịokwu "I like ~" ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ, chọta ụkpụrụ ahụ ma kwuo ya, ma lelee ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e2-b01-11.material: I like milk. → Do you like milk? / I like rice. → Do you like rice? / I like dogs. → Do you like dogs? Chọta ụkpụrụ ahụ ma gbanwee "I like pizza."
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s1.r.b: Usoro okwu dị iche. "Do" bụ nke mbụ.
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: "I" na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ "you," ọ naghị anọgide dị ka "I."
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: Ihe atụ ndị ahụ jiri "Do," ọ bụghị "Does."
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Gbanwee "I" ka ọ bụrụ "you" ma tinye "Do" n'ihu. Ya mere ọ bụ "Do you like pizza?"
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: N'ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile, a na-etinye "Do" n'ihu ma "I" na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ "you," ya mere ọ na-abụ "Do you like pizza?"
l-e-e2-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Ihe atụ niile na-amalite na "Do you like," ya mere otu ụkpụrụ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ maka "pizza."

l-e-e2-b01-12.title: Ụkpụrụ maka okwu na-ewere "es"
l-e-e2-b01-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke okwu na-ewere "es" iji gosi karịa otu, chọta ụkpụrụ ahụ ma kwuo ya, ma lelee ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e2-b01-12.material: bus → buses / box → boxes / dish → dishes. Lelee ụda njedebe nke okwu ndị a, chọta ụkpụrụ ahụ, ma buo amụma ọtụtụ nke fox.
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ ọtụtụ nke "fox" nke na-eso ụkpụrụ ahụ?
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-agbakwunye naanị "s." Okwu na-akwụsị na "x" na-ewere "es."
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s1.r.c: Nke a na-agwakọta ụkpụrụ maka okwu na-akwụsị na "y."
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ karịrị otu, ma ụdị ya na-anọgide otu.
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Okwu na-akwụsị na "s," "x," ma ọ bụ "sh" na-ewere "es." "Fox," nke na-akwụsị na "x," na-abụ "foxes."
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: "Bus," "box," na "dish" na-akwụsị na "s," "x," na "sh" ma na-ewere "es," ya mere "fox," nke na-akwụsị na "x," bụkwa "foxes."
l-e-e2-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile na-agbakwunye "es," ya mere "fox," nke na-akwụsị na "x," ka a na-edekwa "foxes."

l-e-e2-b01-13.material: Where is the cat? — In the box. / Where is Jun? — At school. / Where is the ball? — Under the bed. Chọta ụkpụrụ ahụ ma buo amụma azịza maka "Where is the book?"

l-e-e2-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ aha mmadụ. Azịza maka "Where" bụ ebe.
l-e-e2-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụghị ajụjụ a na-aza site na "Yes."
l-e-e2-b01-13.s.s1.explain: Azịza maka "Where" na-akpọ ebe, dị ka "In," "At," ma ọ bụ "Under." "On the desk" bụ ebe.

l-e-e2-b03-18.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ugboro ole ọ na-ewe ịgụ ederede dị ogologo karịa ederede dị mkpụmkpụ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e2-b03-18.material: Ederede A nwere okwu 45 ederede B nwekwara okwu 100. A na-agụ ederede abụọ ahụ n'otu ọsọ.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ugboro ole ka ịgụ B dị ogologo karịa ịgụ A?
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.o.a: Fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.r.a: B dị ogologo karịa A karịa okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ugboro 10, ọ ga-adị ihe dị ka okwu 450.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ugboro 5, ọ ga-adị ihe dị ka okwu 225.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị were 45 dị ka ihe dị ka 50, mgbe ahụ 100 bụ okpukpu 2 nke 50. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 2.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị tụọ atụmatụ 45 dị ka ihe dị ka 50, 100 bụ okpukpu abụọ nke ya, ya mere oge ịgụ bụkwa ihe dị ka okpukpu 2.
l-e-e2-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Ikewa 100 site na ihe dị ka 45 na-enye ihe dị ka 2, ya mere okpukpu 5 ma ọ bụ okpukpu 10 buru ibu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e2-b03-19.title: Ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu ị nwere ike ịpịnye n'nkeji 1
l-e-e2-b03-19.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu a pịnyere n'nkeji 1, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e2-b03-19.material: Ị nwere ike ịpịnye ihe dị ka okwu 10 n'nkeji 1. Otu ahịrịokwu bụ ihe dị ka okwu 5.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka ahịrịokwu a pịnyere n'nkeji 1?
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ zuru ezu maka ahịrịokwu abụọ nke okwu 5 ọ bụla.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Ị kpara ya ọnụọgụ okwu, 5. Ị ghaghị ikewa 10 site na 5.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Ị mịkọrịtara, ya mere ọ buru ibu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị kpokọta okwu 10 n'ìgwè nke 5, e nwere ìgwè 2. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 2.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Ikewa okwu 10 n'ìgwè nke okwu 5 n'ahịrịokwu ọ bụla na-enye ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 2.
l-e-e2-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu okwu 5 na-adaba ugboro abụọ, ya mere ihe dị ka 2 n'nkeji 1 ziri ezi.

l-e-e2-b03-20.title: Ọnụọgụ okwu omume e chetara
l-e-e2-b03-20.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ okwu omume e chetara taa, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e2-b03-20.material: Taa m mụrụ okwu omume 20. Echetara m ihe dị ka 2/3 nke ha.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ okwu e chetara kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/3, ọ bụghị 2/3.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ okwu niile e mụrụ.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ karịrị okwu e mụrụ.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s1.explain: Ịkewa 20 n'akụkụ 3 hà nhatanụ na-enye ihe dị ka 7 nke ọ bụla, ma abụọ n'ime akụkụ ndị ahụ na-eme ihe dị ka 13. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 13.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: 1/3 nke 20 bụ ihe dị ka 7, ya mere 2/3 bụ ihe dị ka 13.
l-e-e2-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: 2/3 bụ okpukpu abụọ nke 1/3, ya mere ihe dị ka 13, nke bụ okpukpu abụọ nke 7, ziri ezi.

l-e-e2-b04-16.title: Ọnụọgụ apụl maka ndị mmadụ 6
l-e-e2-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ apụl a ga-enye ndị enyi 6, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e2-b04-16.material: Ndị enyi 6 niile sịrị, "I like apples." Ị chọrọ inye onye ọ bụla apụl 2.
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ apụl achọrọ ziri ezi?
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ naanị apụl 1 maka onye ọ bụla.
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ apụl 3 nke ọ bụla.
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla n'ime mmadụ 6 na-enweta 2, mgbe ahụ 6 × 2 = apụl 12.
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Ị na-enye apụl 2 nye onye ọ bụla ma e nwere mmadụ 6, ya mere ị chọrọ ihe dị ka apụl 12 site na 6 × 2.
l-e-e2-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ apụl 2, ugboro 6, ya mere 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 na-eme apụl 12.

l-e-e2-b04-17.title: Ikekọrịta kaadị okwu n'otu aka
l-e-e2-b04-17.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ kaadị okwu mgbe a na-ekekọrịta kaadị 30 n'ìgwè 3, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e2-b04-17.material: Ìgwè 3 na-ekekọrịta kaadị okwu mkpụrụ osisi 30 n'otu aka.
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ kaadị ziri ezi nke otu ìgwè na-enweta?
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Ị gwakọtara ya na ọnụọgụ ìgwè, 3.
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ 30 wepụ 3. Ị ga-ekewa.
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Ịkesa 30 n'otu nha n'ìgwè 3 na-enye 30 ÷ 3 = kaadị 10.
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: Kaadị 10 n'ìgwè nke ọ bụla n'ime ìgwè 3 na-eme ka ha bụrụ kaadị 30, ya mere ìgwè nke ọ bụla ga-enweta ihe dị ka kaadị 10.
l-e-e2-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Ị na-ekewa 30 nha anya n'ìgwè 3, ya mere ìgwè nke ọ bụla na-enweta kaadị 10.

l-e-e2-b04-18.title: Oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'ime ụbọchị 5
l-e-e2-b04-18.goal: Tụọ oge ịgụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-agụ nkeji 20 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 5; họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e2-b04-18.material: Ana m agụ akwụkwọ Bekee nkeji 20 kwa ụbọchị. Tụọ nkeji ole m gụrụ n'ozuzu n'ime ụbọchị 5.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge ịgụ akwụkwọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ 20 gbakwunyere 5. Ọ bụ nkeji 20 kwa ụbọchị, ugboro 5.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ oge maka ụbọchị 10.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: Ị tụrụ obere oge karịa ka o kwesịrị.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 20 ruo ụbọchị 5 bụ 20 × 5 = nkeji 100, nke bụ ihe dị ka awa 1 na nkeji 40.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ nkeji 20 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 5, ya mere 20 × 5 na-enye ihe dị ka nkeji 100.
l-e-e2-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ nkeji 20 ugboro 5, ya bụ 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, ya mere ihe dị ka nkeji 100 ịgụ akwụkwọ.
